text:
Emily: FYI customer FinLedger hit us with a spike and then reported garbage outputs after we rerouted them — they expected redwood/gptx-8k-v2 but got a quantized lite variant.
Raj: Ugh. Do we have the failover logs? which route triggered?
Emily: I pulled the initial support report — they saw a flurry of 401 auth probes from their side, then our routing moved them to eu-west as a fallback. infra-bot posted an automated event: 'route-failover triggered: policy=auth_probe, fallback_region=eu-west-1, fallback_variant=redwood/gptx-lite-8k-quant'.
infra-bot: [automated] route-failover event 2076543215: reason=auth_probe, request_count=320, avg_latency=1.8s, chosen_fallback=redwood/gptx-lite-8k-quant.
Kevin: That variant is not tokenizer-compatible with v2 — vocab+pre-tokenization differences. No wonder outputs got garbled.
Lucas: Customer shows examples where punctuation was stripped and numbers turned into tokens that map to different IDs. They pasted: "Invoice #243 -> Invoice \u003cnumeric\u003e" after failover.
Amanda: Did billing change too? They complained about sudden per-token drop and then weirdly higher token counts. Could be tokenizer mismatch causing fragmentation.
billing-bot: [notice] customer FinLedger invoice 2026-07 flagged: token-count delta +38% for period 2026-07-02 to 2026-07-02 correlated with routing event 2076543215.
Emily: Repro steps I ran from APAC region: 1) Send their prompt to hosted endpoint (region ap-southeast-1) pinned to redwood/gptx-8k-v2 -> OK. 2) Force routing to eu-west fallback using --region override -> served redwood/gptx-lite-8k-quant -> output changed.
Emily: curl repro: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Region: eu-west-1" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gptx-lite-8k-quant","input":"Invoice: 243. Please summarize."}'
```
Raj: Can we check the mapping table that allows lite-quant as compatible fallback? There should be a capability matrix that prevents incompatible tokenizers from being used as fallbacks.
Kevin: Agreed. It looks like routing policy used a coarse compatibility tag ("semantic-similarity") instead of "tokenizer-compatible". I'll grep the policy: ```yaml
fallback_policies:
  - name: latency_threshold
    conditions: ["region_unavailable"]
  - name: capability_fallback
    conditions: ["model_family_match"]
```
Kevin: That "model_family_match" check is too loose — it matched gptx-* across major versions and allowed quantized-lite in EU.
Lucas: Support SLA: customer lost coherency on invoice parsing for ~12 minutes during the incident window (2076543215-2076543935) and it's reproducible for them. They want an RCA and a credit.
Amanda: For immediate mitigation can we 1) disable auto-fallback for this customer, 2) pin them to v2 across regions, and 3) issue a rollback of the fallback policy for eu-west?
infra-bot: [action] Disabled auto-fallback for account FinLedger (acct_fin_987). Route pinned to redwood/gptx-8k-v2 where available.
support-bot: Logged customer ticket #C-2026-789 — requested urgent RCA and billing review.
Kevin: I'll push a policy fix to require "tokenizer_compat=true" for fallback matches. Quick patch will be on staging, ETA 30m.
Raj: Can DevOps also double-check our KV cache invalidation when switching between variants — mismatched KV cache + differing KV key formats can cause subtle corruption.
Kevin: Noted — I'll include KV cache compatibility checks in the patch.
Emily: Customer asked for repro artifacts. I attached the curl, the failing outputs, and the infra-bot event. They also want confirmation their historical invoicing tokens are not corrupted.
Amanda: Billing — we should proactively credit the delta and explain tokenizer mismatch caused token inflation. billing-bot, can you queue a provisional credit?
billing-bot: [action] Provisional credit queued: amount TBD pending exact delta calculation. Creating billing investigation task B-2026-44.
Emily: Next steps: Kevin deploys fallback policy fix + KV checks; Raj verifies region routing logs and flags similar accounts; Amanda coordinates credit and comms; Lucas drafts RCA. I'll keep the customer updated.
Raj: I'll scan the last 24h for route-failover events that selected quantized-lite variants, filter by account tier and tokenizer mismatch.
Lucas: Thanks — please ping me in thread when the quick patch lands, I'll share with FinLedger and ask for repro confirmation. :thumbsup:
Emily: thanks all, keeping this thread as the single source for updates.
